name: allocation-webapp

dependencies.name: allocation-api
dependencies.description: Every screen's data: engagements, allocations, approvals, team allocations, the dashboard, reports, allocation types, partner consultants and access roles.

dependencies.name: skill-suggestion-agent
dependencies.description: Suggests skills for an engagement's scope on the consultant search screen.

description: The single-page app for every signed-in actor: raising and tracking engagements, approving internal work, allocating and clearing consultants, team defaults, the dashboard, reports and admin settings. Holds no business logic and no data of its own — every read and write goes through allocation-api, except AI skill suggestions which go through skill-suggestion-agent.
